newsitem.title: USA: Republic completes Nat'l Car Rental deal.
newsitem.headline: Republic completes Nat'l Car Rental deal.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Tuesday it had completed its previously announced acquisition of National Car Rental System Inc.
The deal is being accounted for as a pooling of interest in which Republic will issue about 21.7 million of its common shares, it said.

National, with headquarters in Minneapolis, Minn., operates a fleet of about 100,000 vehicles in the United States. It has 800 locations in the U.S. and Canada and has marketing affiliations in Latin America, Europe, Japan and the Caribbean.
Republic is a diversified company with units in the automotive, solid waste and electronic security industries.
